files.content:
name: gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/README.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/MANIFEST.md'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/sync-stable-readers.js'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  sync:
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Execute Existing Alignment Sync
        run: |
          node -e "
          const fs = require('fs');
          const path = require('path');
          const depMap = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json', 'utf8'));
          for (const [src, dst] of Object.entries(depMap.mappings || {})) {
            if (fs.existsSync(src)) {
              fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
              fs.copyFileSync(src, dst);
            }
          }
          if (depMap.sentinel_file) {
            fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(depMap.sentinel_file), { recursive: true });
            fs.writeFileSync(depMap.sentinel_file, new Date().toISOString() + '\\n');
          }
          "

      - name: Execute Stable Readers Sync
        run: node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/sync-stable-readers.js

      - name: Commit Sync Changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No sync changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(sync): update dependencies and stable readers [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

files.purpose: Workflow managing truth-reader challenges, dispatching creation on selector changes and atomic verification/restoration on active projection edits
files.content:
name: truth-reader-challenge

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-selector.json'
      - 'ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  process-challenge:
    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Determine Trigger Mode
        id: trigger_mode
        run: |
          COMMITTED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD || true)
          echo "Committed files: $COMMITTED_FILES"
          if echo "$COMMITTED_FILES" | grep -q "ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-selector.json"; then
            echo "mode=selector" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif echo "$COMMITTED_FILES" | grep -q "ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/"; then
            echo "mode=worker_evidence" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "mode=selector" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run Challenge Creator
        if: steps.trigger_mode.outputs.mode == 'selector'
        run: |
          node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/truth-challenge-engine.js create

      - name: Commit Created Challenge
        if: steps.trigger_mode.outputs.mode == 'selector'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/active-projections/ ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/truth-status.json .truth_challenge/snapshots/
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No new challenge created."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): publish seeded challenge projections [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi

      - name: Run Verification
        if: steps.trigger_mode.outputs.mode == 'worker_evidence'
        run: |
          node ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/scripts/truth-challenge-engine.js verify

      - name: Commit Verification Result
        if: steps.trigger_mode.outputs.mode == 'worker_evidence'
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if git diff --staged --quiet; then
            echo "No state changes to commit."
          else
            git commit -m "chore(truth-reader): challenge verification update [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
